requires.n: One-drop creature with a second body

1957-4050-4616--204.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the one-drop creature, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, it and Moldervine Reclamation trigger.
Resolve the creature's ability, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation ability, gaining 1 life and drawing a card.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the one-drop creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token creature, adding one colored mana.
Cast the creature by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1844-3899-5571--6.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least X.
1844-3899-5571--6.description:
Use Fateful Handoff to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 2.

341-1170-2981-5131--202.easyPrerequisites:
Umori has "Artifact" chosen.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
341-1170-2981-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Umori.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn
Repeat.

3532-5078-7010-7864.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
3532-5078-7010-7864.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Ravenhill Flock triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

553-4668-7467.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Heliod, the Warped Eclipse.
In response, cast Sudden Setback by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2897-4753.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2897-4753.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Clever Impersonator and Gigantoplasm each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Gigantoplasm trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2897-4753.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1379-2919-5641-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1379-2919-5641-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

4872-7715-7722.easyPrerequisites: The Mighty Thor doesn't have summoning sickness.
4872-7715-7722.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using The Mighty Thor.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Time Warp from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Time Warp from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

2741-4017-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2741-4017-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1013-6500.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Tephraderm indestructible.
1013-6500.description:
Activate Tephraderm by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Tephraderm triggers, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Step 2 repeats in an infinite loop, causing the game to end in a draw.

2450-4050-6556-7639.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
2450-4050-6556-7639.description:
Cast Whim of Volrath by paying {U} due to Temur Battlecrier.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Whim of Volrath.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat.

141-4050-7449.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 4 or less.
141-4050-7449.description:
Cast Stir the Grave by paying {4}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Stir the Grave.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Stir the Grave
Resolve the Stir the Grave copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-6871-6879-7298.description:
Cast Firdoch Core by paying {3}.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Firdoch Core.
When Firdoch Core dies, Haru triggers, returning Firdoch Core from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.

891-2921-3055.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

4659-7282-7322.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Big Mother Mouser with haste. It enters with two +1/+1 counters.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Big Mother Mouser token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Big Mother Mouser token dies, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Robot artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Robots, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
4659-7282-7322.notes: If you have enough mana, you can forego steps 2 through 4 to get infinite creature tokens with haste.

1477-3621-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard with haste.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.
1477-3621-7282.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can just do step 1 repeatedly.

2438-2730-3175.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4927-5921-5970-7014.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of North Pole Patrol.
Activate one of the North Pole Patrol tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other North Pole Patrol token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

719-2366-6798-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
719-2366-6798-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to an untapped land you control

562-651-3588.description:
Activate Warrior en-Kor by paying {0}.
Task Force triggers, giving it +0/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate the land with Animal Boneyard attached by tapping it and sacrificing Task Force, causing you to gain life equal to Task Force's toughness.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet

1974-2760-3108.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Quicksilver Gargantuan.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Quicksilver Gargantuan by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1182-1793-5220.description:
Cast Stonecoil Serpent by paying {0}.
Stonecoil Serpent enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Harvester of Souls.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Stonecoil Serpent from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Harvester of Souls trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Stonecoil Serpent from your library.
Repeat.

4871-5695-6019-6797.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Infested Thrinax and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Infested Thrinax trigger, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train abilities from steps 3 and 7, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is a creature without summoning sickness

478-539-5168--111.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three colors among permanents you control.
478-539-5168--111.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Bloom Tender.
Repeat.

2933-4499-4785-5798.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

1742-4798-5632.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
1742-4798-5632.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Chalk Outline triggers. Holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a 2/2 Detective creature token and a Clue token.
Repeat from step 2.

45-3918-4038.description:
Activate Trazyn using Khalni Gem's ability by tapping it, adding {2}.
Activate Trazyn using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Trazyn.
Repeat.

1987-2239-4276-4823.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-2239-4276-4823.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Ardent Elementalist and Timeless Witness.
When Ardent Elementalist and Timeless Witness enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2239-4276-4823.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

428-1692-1694-3090.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
You have enough mana to cast Harmless Offering.
Helm of the Host attached to Ghyrson Starn.
428-1692-1694-3090.description:
Cast Harmless Offering by paying its mana cost, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Ghyrson Starn that isn't legendary.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn's trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 5.

240-526-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Egg creature tokens.
240-526-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Egg.
When the Egg dies, Atla Palani triggers, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, if it has power 4 or greater, Life Finds a Way triggers, creating a copy of an Egg token you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Egg's power.
Repeat.
240-526-5256.notes: This combo will only fetch every creature in your library if all creatures have power 4 or greater. You may use additional Egg tokens to grab as many creatures as possible.

2452-3249-5670-5708--56.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2452-3249-5670-5708--56.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast a Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, Vein Ripper triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2178-2962-4221.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Pirate Ship.
Pirate Ship does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to give Pirate Ship deathtouch.
Thornbite Staff attached to Pirate Ship.
Pirate Ship does not have summoning sickness.
2178-2962-4221.description:
Activate Pirate Ship by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any land an opponent controls.
The land dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When the land dies, Pirate Ship triggers, untapping Pirate Ship.
Repeat.
You may repeat this loop whenever a land enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature with toughness equal to 1 enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.
Give Pirate Ship deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Pirate Ship by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any creature an opponent controls, and destroying it due to Pirate Ship's deathtouch.
When the creature dies, Pirate Ship triggers, untapping Pirate Ship.
Repeat from step 2.
If the effect giving Pirate Ship deathtouch is a static effect, you may repeat this whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

2764-3263.description: Cast Hurkyl's Recall by paying {1}{U}, causing an opponent to return all permanents they own to their hand.

1329-1636-3180.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1636-3180.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Chamber Sentry from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Chamber Sentry by paying {0}.
Chamber Sentry enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

643-1909.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {G}.
643-1909.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Repeat.

1479-2692-3478.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2692-3478.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it, Felidar Retreat, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
